meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问式对话完善计划或设计，并同步生成 ADR 与术语表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在推进复杂方案时犹豫不决，需要有人帮你挖出逻辑漏洞并留下清晰记录。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test complex designs and keep a clear decision trail.

howto.what: 这个技能会让 Claude 主持一场“盘问式”访谈,用来打磨你的计划或设计。访谈过程中,它会同步生成 ADR(架构决策记录)和词汇表文档。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用 grill-with-docs 技能,对计划或设计进行盘问式审查时触发。

say.text: 用 grill-with-docs 帮我盘问这个产品方案。
say.note: 会开始严格访谈并生成文档。

say.text: 请对这个架构设计开一次 /grilling。
say.note: 同步产生 ADR 和词汇表。

say.text: 打磨一下我的计划,按 grill-with-docs 来。
say.note: 访谈中会自动记录决策。

howto.what_en: Claude will run a relentless interview session to sharpen a plan or design, while creating ADRs and a glossary during the process.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks for grill-with-docs to interrogate a plan or design.

say_en.text: Use grill-with-docs to grill this product plan.
say_en.note: Strict interview starts and docs are generated.

say_en.text: Run a /grilling on this architecture design.

say_en.note: Decisions get recorded along the way.
